slices.focus: Full apartment reorganization with a dedicated work-free reading nook to stop the home from feeling like overflow storage
slices.summary: Hannah and Priya finally reorganize their cluttered apartment, carving out a reading nook that is explicitly work-free — a small chair, lamp, and books that are narrative nonfiction and mysteries, not binders pretending to be reading.
